none: PAS NLM-30885F: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, possibly of House of Valentinian (364-378) [from reverse], though the style strongly resembles the small fallen horseman copies of 355-361. Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust cuirassed and diademed right, large eye. Reverse description: probably Victory advancing left with wreath and palm, haphazard partial legend. Reverse inscription: SEC[VRITAS REI PVBLICAE].…
